candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, propagating 502s to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs; root cause within redis (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) in traces; inventory returns 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating to gateway. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Redis-side telemetry is absent, so the internal redis fault mode remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics (latency, connections, CPU) during incident window
Redis logs or error events for reserve_inventory timeouts
Gateway logs (excluded evidence) to confirm error propagation
